meta.title: Infrastructure efficiency audit — Sunaray Gaon
meta.ward_field: Ward 16 (field / RTI usage) · map to LGD PRI ward I–X on ground
meta.rule: Portal claim ≠ ground delivery. Unknown stays unknown. No person names.

claims.label: Working household taps (FHTC)
claims.ground_reality: Zero functional household taps in 2026 survey ground record. Tank for the ward built ~1 year ago; source still not connected to homes.
claims.contradiction: Physical tank exists without live FHTCs — delivery incomplete regardless of any future portal “complete” claim.
claims.citizen_right: Right to the FHTC / drinking-water scheme list for this habitation (RTI §6; proactive disclosure of scheme delivery).
claims.next_step: Publish JJM FHTC list for Sunaray (Simana) Gaon; record contractor, source, completion date; capture Work ID from eGram/JJM into gov-works.json.

claims.label: Ward tank connected to water source
claims.ground_reality: Operator / ground note: tank built; source not connected — so taps cannot work.
claims.citizen_right: Right to works and asset records for the water tank (sanction, contractor, status).
claims.next_step: Photograph tank with date; match eGram/JJM work or asset ID; RTI Q6–Q7.

claims.label: Usable mobile / internet at home
claims.ground_reality: Community-reported critical connectivity. Unstable signal taxes remittances, scheme OTPs, and tele-medicine.
claims.citizen_right: Right to know public digital-connectivity programmes planned for this GP/block (not private phone metadata).
claims.next_step: Spot-check signal 3×/day (carrier + bars); check BharatNet service-ready and PM-WANI presence; demand GP resolution for tower/backhaul.

claims.label: Main access road complete
claims.ground_reality: Main access still incomplete; walking paths unsafe. Road is a tax on school, health, and schemes.
claims.citizen_right: Right to ward-wise works list, expenditure, and held-up/incomplete works on eGramSwaraj (RTI Q1, Q9).
claims.next_step: Capture PMGSY package ID or eGram work ID; ground photo pair; update gov-works.json.

claims.label: Public solar assets inventoried
claims.ground_reality: Not inventoried on this platform. Do not invent scheme coverage.
claims.citizen_right: Right to complete Asset Register including solar/street assets (ownership, funding, location).
claims.next_step: Walk inventory + RTI Q7 asset register; add rows only when counted.

claims.label: GP asset register public for this ward
claims.ground_reality: No public works/asset board on this OS yet. RTI Q7–Q9 filed as drafted.
claims.citizen_right: Constitutional/statutory right under RTI Act 2005 to know what the Gram Panchayat does: assets, abandoned works, held-up works, minutes, expenditure.
claims.next_step: File/receipt RTI; on reply, fill gov-works.json and tick answer_matrix.

claims.label: Citizen right to know panchayat works & decisions
claims.value: RTI drafted · clock not started (no PIO receipt yet)
claims.ground_reality: Filing rti-lgp-2026-001 prepared 2026-07-16: works, minutes, water/FHTC, assets, abandoned/held-up works. Public site shows meta only.
claims.portal_claim: eGramSwaraj / Meri Panchayat should already disclose many of these under proactive transparency.
claims.contradiction: Mandatory disclosure culture weak on this OS: census + story exist; audited fund/works board does not.
claims.citizen_right: Every citizen has the right to information about Gram Panchayat works, schemes, minutes, assets, and expenditure (RTI Act 2005 §4 & §6). Opacity is a finding, not a pass.
claims.next_step: Obtain diary/speed-post/email ack → set receipt in rti-filings.json → public 30-day clock.
